scope: Read-only independent saved-array and source review. No matcher, source prediction, mask generation, GT evaluation, simulator, navigation or tests executed. Loaded only saved prediction arrays/masks/body/time; no renderer depth-label/GT pixels loaded. Computed pointwise count/window arithmetic only. Only this independent_review.json is written.

intervention_control_static_review.single_intervention: diagnose.py:47-54 copies archived uint8 RGB, applies255-RGB only at each frozen CADtrue pixel and asserts all outside-CAD bytes unchanged. RGB color inversion has no alternate colors/threshold sweep. Perturbed RGB is not separately saved, so the input intervention scope is supported by frozen code/runtime assertions and input SHA, rather than an independently stored perturbed-image audit.
intervention_control_static_review.native_source: diag predict uses same old.CONFIG/positive+negative disparities, rotations, black448 padding, old.depths LR and old.points/body as frozen native source. It creates only OpenCV matcher objects, never FourSGBM/RobotSelfMask; no fresh CAD generation. Eight two-arm/frame predict calls times four matcher calls gives32; normal0 guard enforces count.
intervention_control_static_review.baseline: All64 scalar image arrays and48 world/query/partner point arrays independently compare dtype/shape/raw bytes against archived original predictions. All16 CAD arrays and body/time are unchanged across saved arms.

local_support_rectangle_review.limitation: This protects the original selected/rounded query-partner unary rectangles only. It does not prove that all competing disparity hypotheses, LR partner inference, subpixel neighbor costs, median/speckle postprocessing or whole-SGM paths are independent of CAD-interior RGB. Altered accepted depth/validity cannot be assigned uniquely to the SGM recurrence from this diagnostic.

conceptual_nonrepeat_and_followon_review.new_signal: Prior padding diagnosis changed fabricated off-image pixels while measured RGB stayed fixed. This experiment keeps padding fixed and changes actual measured pixels marked by frozen known-self CAD. It is a distinct nuisance-dependency intervention on the same preselected four frames, not another padding/color sweep or evidence that old v120 benefit gates passed.

Keep exact cost values, decoder/evidence consumer, image domain, camera/source parameters and fixed accuracy gates otherwise frozen; explicitly state which support boolean is changed and where it is consumed. It remains a controlled numerical reference, not an OpenCV-equivalent single-factor native-source repair.
conceptual_nonrepeat_and_followon_review.budget_boundary: The proposed follow-on cap4 may explicitly inherit this completed diagnostic as1 plus one interface/predict/GT-score each, with recovery0/physics0. conceptual_nonrepeat_and_followon_review.no_admission: No CAD-support repair code, synthetic interface, actual four-frame repair prediction or GT benefit qualification is assessed as completed here.

valid_conclusion: On these fixed four frames, frozen native output has a witnessed dependency on CAD-known-self RGB:866 of12052 original risk queries whose original two local unary rectangles are CAD-free lost valid depth or shifted by>.15m under the single known-self inversion. This is nuisance-dependency evidence, not proof of which original/perturbed depth is wrong.
limits: Frozen CAD is a known-self proxy, not verified per-pixel ground truth of actual robot/scene boundaries.
No inference of wrong metric depth, calibrated uncertainty, semantics, observed free space, physical false obstacles, performance benefit or safe navigation.
.15m is a predeclared diagnostic change criterion, not a calibrated error/safety threshold or estimated confidence.
Four development frames and the original-selected risk population are a conditional finite scope, not independent generalization or a complete population of possible detections.
Proposed local CAD-support exclusion could alter regularization context and support coverage; full fixed-domain evidence is needed before any repair benefit claim.
